title: Miniature Sunglasses Try-On Diorama
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D miniature sunglasses try-on diorama using Three.js.

SCENE SETUP:
- Load the 'LittlestTokyo.glb' model using GLTFLoader (from CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js and DRACOLoader from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/DRACOLoader.js). Set DRACO decoder path to 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/libs/draco/'. Place the diorama model at position (0, -1, 0) and scale it to 0.01 so it appears as a miniature tabletop scene.
- Create a flat circular platform (radius 5, height 0.2) beneath the diorama as a turntable base, colored #3a3a3a.
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at (0, 1, 0).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow=true.
- Enable renderer shadows.

SUNGLASSES PRODUCT DISPLAY:
- Create 4 pairs of sunglasses as 3D objects using simple geometry (thin torus for frames, flat box for lenses, thin cylinders for arms). Position them floating in an arc above the diorama at y=3.5, spaced evenly.
- Each pair has a different style:
  - Style 0: 'Aviator' - gold frame (#FFD700), dark grey lenses, opacity 0.6
  - Style 1: 'Wayfarer' - black frame (#111111), brown lenses (#4A2800), opacity 0.7
  - Style 2: 'Round' - silver frame (#C0C0C0), blue lenses (#0044AA), opacity 0.5
  - Style 3: 'Sport' - red frame (#CC0000), mirror lenses (#88CCFF), opacity 0.4
- Each sunglasses group should have a subtle floating animation (bobbing up and down with Math.sin, amplitude 0.15, different phase offsets).

INTERACTION:
- Clicking on a sunglasses pair selects it. The selected pair should scale up to 1.5x and move down to y=2.0 (animated over 0.5s). Previously selected pair returns to original position and scale.
- Add a 'Try On' button (DOM). When clicked with a pair selected, the selected sunglasses animate down to y=1.2 and orient to face the camera, simulating a try-on view. The diorama turntable rotates slowly when in try-on mode.
- Add a 'Reset' button (DOM) that returns everything to initial state: sunglasses back to arc, turntable stops, selection cleared.
- Add a 'Rotate Left' and 'Rotate Right' button that rotate the turntable by 45 degrees (animated).
- Keyboard: press 1-4 to select sunglasses style 0-3. Press 'T' to toggle try-on mode. Press 'R' to reset.
- Add a color picker input (id='lensTintPicker') that changes the lens color/tint of the currently selected sunglasses in real-time.

HUD/UI:
- Display current selected style name in a div with id='selectedLabel' (text like 'Selected: Aviator' or 'None' if nothing selected).
- Display try-on status in a div with id='tryOnStatus' ('Try-On: Active' or 'Try-On: Inactive').
- Display turntable rotation angle (degrees, rounded to integer) in a div with id='turntableAngle'.
- Style buttons with class 'control-btn', positioned at bottom of screen.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- selectedIndex: number (-1 for none, 0-3 for selected pair)
- selectedName: string ('None', 'Aviator', 'Wayfarer', 'Round', 'Sport')
- tryOnActive: boolean
- turntableAngleDeg: number (degrees, 0-360 range, rounded to integer)
- sunglassesPositions: array of 4 objects with {x, y, z} for each pair's current position
- sunglassesScales: array of 4 numbers (scale factor for each pair)
- lensTintColor: string (hex color of current selected lens tint)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when GLB is loaded)
- dioramaVisible: boolean
- turntableRotating: boolean (true when turntable is actively spinning in try-on mode)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Sunglasses float with sinusoidal bobbing (amplitude 0.15). Selection animation is smooth interpolation over 0.5s. Turntable rotates at constant angular velocity when in try-on mode. All positions must remain NaN-free. Turntable angle wraps within 0-360 range.
